core_purpose: TypeScript client SDK for the API Mom unified-egress proxy, designed for Cloudflare Workers to route external API calls (Gemini, YouTube, etc.) with automatic cost attribution. Provides Pino-style chainable child clients plus platform utilities for D1 query instrumentation, Analytics Engine metrics, and pre-flight budget checks.

architecture.backend: Cloudflare Workers (TypeScript SDK targeting Workers runtime via service bindings or fetch)
architecture.database: D1 (instrumented via Proxy wrapper; no schema owned by this repo)

main_features.name: Chainable .child(service, context) scoping with auto X-Function/X-Tags headers
Service binding support (Worker-to-Worker, avoids CF error 1042)
GET/POST proxy methods + internal route caller (/v1/budget, etc.)
Budget governor (checkBudget pre-flight with fail-open fallback)

technical_debt: No test suite exists (no test runner, no test files, no test script in package.json). No CI/CD workflow — `.github/` directory is absent, so publishes to npm are manual via `prepublishOnly`. README repository URL (`github.com/apimom/client.git`) does not match the actual GitHub remote, which can break npm provenance and `npm repo` links. checkBudget defaults to fail-open on errors, which is pragmatic but could mask outages of the API Mom router. `package-lock.json` was deleted in favor of `pnpm-lock.yaml` but neither change is committed yet (working tree dirty). Several `as unknown as` casts in platform.ts proxy code reflect weak typing of D1 meta responses.
active_roadmap: Add GitHub Actions workflow for CI (typecheck/build/format) and automated npm publish on git tag — currently no CI exists and releases are fully manual (Issue: GitHub Actions: CI + npm publish on tag)
